book.name: Luk
book.title: LUK Jiysis Krays Minim Tep Luk Tikak

content: Biyomb Paylat Jiysis Kor Nup Ak Niŋak
Kun aŋgiy, maŋgiysek tikjakiy, Jiysis nup dand gapman biyomb Paylat mindek ak amniyak.

Dand amiy, nup kor giniŋg, minim okok nimb okok nimb dand apiy aŋgyak, “Chin piyow niŋiy niŋbun; bi biy biynimb chinup gok aŋgip, ‘Biyomb yimb Siysa nup takes ma pikiy, gapman kay minim ak kunep ma niŋnimimb aŋgip.’ Pen minim bap aŋgip, ‘Yand Krays, bi kiyŋ bap aŋgip’ aŋgyak.”
Aŋgeyak, Paylat Jiysis nup aŋgniŋiy aŋgak, “Nand Jiwda kay kiyŋ kiyk ak mindpan akaŋ?” “Aŋgek aŋgak, “Mey apan ak, aŋgak.”
Aŋgek, Paylat pen, bi Gor nup simboŋgep yomb gok sek, biynimb yikop ap mindeyak gok sek kuyip aŋgak, “Yand niŋbiyn; bi biy nup kor gep junj bap ma mindip aŋgak.”

Kun aŋgak ak pen, kiyk meŋg miŋgan dand araniy aŋgyak, “Nuk gapman minim ma niŋnimimb aŋgiy, biynimb miñmon Jiwdiya okok maŋgiysek aŋgñimb. Miñmon Galiyliy tikiy, aŋgñi dap dap, miñiy Jerusalem biy wip aŋgyak.”
Jiysis Nup Dand Herot Mindek Amniyak
Aŋgeyak, Paylat kuyip aŋgniŋiy aŋgak, “Bi kun biy Galiyliy nimb?”
Aŋgek, yaw aŋgey, biyomb Herot Galiyliy propens kond mindip ak, ap Jerusalem biy mindip rek, nup ker yoken kor biy niŋnimuŋ aŋgiy, kuyip aŋgek, dand mindek ak amniyak.
Herot, Jiysis tap giyiŋgip ak per minim anep niŋiy, minek akay rek, tap mageprek bap gek niŋniŋgayn aŋgiy, gos ak niŋmindyiŋgip ak mey, ñin kun ak Jiysis nup dand apchakey niŋiy, nuk miñmiñ yimb gak.
Pen Herot Jiysis nup minim kuŋaynep yiŋgin wiŋgin gek, Jiysis pen minim bap ma aŋgak.
Pen bi Gor nup tap simboŋgep yomb gok sek, bi low tiysa gok sek kilis giy, minim kuŋaynep aŋgyak.
Herot, amiybi nuk gok yip, Jiysis nup gi timey giyiŋg, ñiñloŋ ayiŋg, gapman biyomb aypay chech tep bap yimñiy, tip ak Paylat mindek ak dand amniyak.
Nind Herot yip, Paylat yip penpen aŋgmindyiŋgipiyr ak pen; ñin kun ak minim aŋg jimñirik.
Paylat Jiysis Nup Ñaŋgnimimb Aŋgak
Pen Paylat, biyomb Gor nup tap simboŋgep gok sek, bi minim tuŋgasikep gok sek, biynimb yikop gok sek aŋgek, ap nan-gey aŋgak,
“Yip apim, ‘Bi biy, biynimb gok kuyip kun kun aŋgip apim’ ak pen, miñiy windin yirik ar nimbip biy kor gipiyn ak, minim kor ginimbik junj bap mindek, ma niŋbiyn.
Herot kunep minim junj bap ma piyow niŋiy mey; chinup ker tip ak aŋgyokamb dand opay. Bi kun biy, tap timey bap gek rek, minim nimbip ak diy nup ñaŋgnim.
Kun ak yikop pikiy, aŋgyoken amnaŋ aŋgak.” [
Jiwda ñin yomb kiyk “Pasopa” aŋgyiŋgipay ak apek, Paylat per kalambis bi kiyk bap yikop aŋgyokyiŋgip ak mey;]
ñin kun ak, kiyk maŋgiysek meŋg miŋgan dand araniy aŋgyak, “Bi kun ak ñaŋgay, Barabas nup aŋgyokem chinup ker owaŋ aŋgyak!”
Bi Barabas kun ak, dawin yomb namb ak, biynimb gunap diy penpen giy, bi bap pisnep pikayak rek nup kor giy kalambis ayak.
Pen Paylat tip ak, meŋg miŋgan dand araniy kuyip aŋgak, “Jiysis nup yikop aŋgyoken amnaŋ aŋgak.”
Aŋgek, kiyk meŋg miŋgan dand araniy aŋgyak, “Nup mon kiros bak biyoŋ ñaŋgbirik ayim aŋgyak!” “Nup mon kiros bak biyoŋ ñaŋgbirik ayim aŋgyak.”
Aŋgeyak, Paylat tip ak kuyip aŋgak, “Yenen? Bi kun biy, tap yerip timey gip? Nup niŋen tap timey bap ma gip ak, ñaŋgjun rek ma ayip. Kun ak nup yikop pikiy, aŋgyoken amnaŋ aŋgak.”
Aŋgek, kiyk kilis yimb giyiŋg, Jiysis nup ñaŋgbirik aynimimb aŋgiy, aŋg gey gey,
Paylat minim kuyip ak diy,
bi timey biynimb kuŋay diy, penpen giy, bi bap nup pikayak anup kirgek amnakniŋ aŋgak, “Jiysis nup ñaŋg aynimimb aŋgak.”
Jiysis Nup Mon Bak Biyoŋ Ñaŋgbirik Ayak

Jiysis nup ñaŋgniŋg dand saŋdiyakniŋ, biynimb kuŋaynep kisen giy amniyak. Namb okok amyiŋg niŋyak; bi Saymon, miñmon Sayriyniy nimb ak, Jerusalem apek. Nup niŋiy, mon kiros di wanjrem ar nup ak ayñiyiŋg aŋgyak, “Jiysis amjap ak kisen amnoŋ aŋgey,” dand kisen gak. Pen biynimb kuŋaynep ameyak namb kun ak, biyn gunap Jiysis nup simb niŋiy siy aŋgey,
nuk tuŋgandikiy kuyip aŋgak, “Nimb Jerusalem biyn! Yip giniŋg gisap ak siy ma aŋgnimimb. Nimbip timey giy, ñapan nimbip gok timey giy giniŋgamb ak, siy aŋgnimimb!
Kisen miker yomb asaw ak apek, aŋgniŋgambay, ‘Biyn ñapan ma tikpay gok sek, biyn ñapan tiy ma ñimbay gok sek tep, aŋgniŋgambay.’
“Ñin kun ak, yenen mindiy kumjun aŋgiy aŋgniŋgambay, ‘Miñmon yirik gok paŋg apiy, chinup pikaypikop akaŋ, konjiy diy chinup yiw gipkop ak, tep aŋgniŋgambay.’
“Yip mon kim tep, timey ma giniŋgiy rek ak pen, timey giniŋg gispay. Nimb mon milip rek wiŋind amiy mindpim ak, nimbip niŋind giniŋgambay aŋgak.”
Pen bi gapman low minim timbrikrik omiŋal ak, mon kiros bak biyoŋ ñaŋgbirik ayniŋg, dand sesek amniyak.
Dand miñmon Chip jun won apay ak amjakiy, bi gapman low timbrikrik omiŋal ak pis pis ñaŋgbirikiy, Jiysis nup namb biyaŋ ñaŋgbirikyak.

Nup kun giy, ñaŋgbirik ayey, nuk Nop nup aŋgak, “Bapiy. Yip gispay ak yerip gispun aŋgiy, niŋrep giy ma gispay. Kun ak kuyip niŋiy kirginimin aŋgak.” Pen amiybi gok, Jiysis nup mon kiros bak biyoŋ ñaŋgbirik ay, chech nup tuŋgjiw ayey mindek gok, kiyk key sandiw gipay rek ak giyiŋg diyak.

Biynimb kuŋaynep niŋmindyakniŋ, Jiwda biyomb gok, Jiysis nup panj aŋgiy aŋgyak, “Nuk ‘Yand Jiwda Kiyŋ yomb key yimb ak; Gor yip damb nuk yip mindpiyn aŋgiy,’ biynimb gunap kumey gamb tikjakpay. Gip kun ak rek, nuk key kunep giy, kim amek niŋun aŋgyak.”
Pen amiybi gok kunep nup panj aŋgyiŋg, maŋ siŋak apiy, ñiŋg silik ak ñiyiŋg aŋgyak,
“Nand Jiwda bi kiyŋ yomb kiyk mindpiyn apan ak, nand key giy kim amnoŋ akaŋ aŋgyak!”
Pen mon boŋg band bap, Jiysis nup ñaŋgrimbikyak mon kiros bak biyoŋ, yimb tikay aŋgyak, “Jiwda biynimb kiyŋ yomb kiyk ak aŋgyak.”
Bi low minim timbriker, mon kiros bak biyoŋ ñaŋgbirikyak omiŋal ak, bap Jiysis nup aŋgak, “Nand Jiwda Kiyŋ yomb key yimb mindpan ak, nand key giy kim amiy, chirup kunep gey, kim amnur aŋgak.”
Aŋgek, bi bap nup pen aŋg giy aŋgak, “Chir miker dipur rek, nuk kunep dip ak, nand Gor nup ma pirikpan?
Chirmiŋay timey gipur rek yiwur dispur, pen Jiysis tap bap ma giy, yikop nep yiwur disap aŋgak.”
Kun aŋgiy, Jiysis nup aŋgak, “Kisen nand Biyomb Kiyŋ mindiy winiŋgamban ñin ak, yip gosimb niŋnimin aŋgak.”
Kun aŋgek, Jiysis aŋgak, “Nip niŋind yimb aspiyn. Miñiy ñin biy, yand yip am tip tep ak mindeniŋgambur aŋgak.”
Jiysis Kumak
Ñin kun ak, pumbnamb yomb yoŋ won ak kisyim apiy, mind dand amiy pumb kuyim gak won ak, tip ak pen melik gak.

Pen Jiysis kumniŋg aŋgak, “Bapiy. Kawnan yand ak ñin ar nip ak aysipiyn aŋgiy,” kumakniŋ, Gor aŋgniŋep korip ñiluk miŋgan suŋrep yimb biyaŋ, laplap di kinjeŋrumb pil giyak ak, puŋgrik biyoŋ biyaŋ ay, miŋgan yikiy mindek.
Pen amiybi kond mindep kiyk ak, Jiysis minim aŋgiy kumak kun ak niŋiy, Gor nup yimb ak dand aranyiŋg aŋgak, “Niŋind apay; bi tep yimb ak aŋgak.”
Biynimb ap mindeyak gok, tap gak kun ak niŋiy, simb yimb gakniŋ, andkind korip kiyk amniyak.
Pen Jiysis buŋgiy nuk gok sek, biyn Galiyliy nimb wiyak gok sek kiyk keykey siŋbindoŋ mindiy, tap gak kun ak niŋmindeyak.
Jiysis Nup Komyak

Pen bi Jiwda minim tuŋgasikep, Gor minim di tep yimb giyiŋgip bap, miñmon Armatiya mindyiŋgip. Yimb nuk ak Josep. Nuk bi minim tuŋgasikep gunap, Jiysis nup ñaŋg ayun aŋgiy, gos niŋyak rek ma niŋak. Nuk Gor biynimb diy kond mindeniŋgamb ñin ak, maŋ mindip aŋgiy, kond mindyiŋgip.
Nuk Jiysis nup dam komniŋg, Paylat mindek ak am aŋgniŋek, yaw aŋgek,
bi gunap yip am Jiysis nup tuŋgasik dand apyapiy, chech tund teprep yimb ak di kom kom giy, dam kamb miŋgan kisen nep kilukiy chip ma komyak miŋgan ak komyak.
Pen Jiwda lotiw ñin ak, maŋ gip aŋgiy, Praydey duŋgep won ak, Jiysis nup kun giy dam komyak.
Pen biyn tiwin, Jiysis yip Galiyliy nimb wiyak gok, Josep amnakniŋ kisen amiy, Jiysis nup komyak tip ak niŋrep giy, andkind korip amniyak.
Amiy, wel kuy tep wak gunap, Jiysis mumbwak nup ak ayñinjun aŋgiy, gay tep giyak. Minek kun anep dand ambiyap ak pen, Sarirey ñin ak, ñin yomb kiyk yikop mindep ak niŋiy mey, yikop mind mind kinyak.
